recentItems.title: From Journey to Sword of the Sea: Austin Wintory on His Most Ambitious Game Scores | Full Interview
recentItems.description:
Whether it's writing Grammy-winning scores or orchestrating the GDC Developer's Concert, it seems like Austin Wintory's work is never done. And he loves it. 

Watch the 2026 concert here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xae7FYq7g2U&t=14s

Austin Wintory is the award-winning composer behind iconic music scores like Sword of the Sea, Journey, Stray Gods: The Roleplaying Musical, and more. In his "spare time," not only does he help produce instructional videos to help inspire future creators, he also organizes and orchestrates the annual GDC Developer's Concert. 

In this interview with GDC Side Quest (part of the Game Developer Podcast), Austin Wintory takes us behind the scenes of the annual game developer's concert, sharing his thought process and inspiration that goes into celebrating some of the industry's most iconic music. He also talks about his creative process and how he uses YouTube to share his knowledge with the world.  

GDC returns this March 1-5, 2027, in San Francisco!

recentItems.title: Clair Obscur Expedition 33: Small Team, Massive Game | Technical Secrets Behind Making Hit RPG
recentItems.description:
There were only four programmers behind Clair Obscur: Expedition 33: How did they do it? 

In this 2026 GDC Festival of Gaming session, go behind the scenes of programming the award-winning RPG with Sandfall Interactive’s Tom Guillermin and Florian Torres. 

With a scope of 30+ hours of story content and an equal amount of side content, the team aimed to give designers maximum creative freedom by enabling them to create and combine gameplay elements. Explore the technical choices made to support that goal, the challenges they faced along the way, and how it all came together to make one of the year’s biggest games.

recentItems.title: GDC Concert 2026: Expedition 33, Hades II, DOOM (2016), and more; feat. Austin Wintory & Troy Baker
recentItems.description:
Performed live for the [GDC] Festival of Gaming 2026, The Developer's Concert is a celebration of video games through video game music. Conductor Austin Wintory takes a live orchestra through performances of iconic scores from the year, as well as personal selections of music from across video game music history.

The GDC Developers Concert returns for its third year, bringing together world-class musicians, composers, and performers to celebrate the incredible music that shapes our gaming experiences. Grammy and BAFTA-winning composer Austin Wintory returned to the GDC Stage with voice actor Troy Baker (The Last of Us, Bioshock: Infinite) to celebrate another year of iconic game music. The blockbuster performance featured music from Rift of the Necrodancer, Hades II, ABZU, and more—not to mention some of the biggest scores and soundtracks from the past year of gaming. Stay until the end for a special surprise featuring Clair Obscur: Expedition 33! 
 
Known for his groundbreaking scores for Journey, Abzu, The Banner Saga, Sword of the Sea, Stray Gods, and many more, Austin has redefined the role of music in games, earning global acclaim for his innovative and emotionally resonant compositions.
